title: Pick the Merchant Portal look
question: Three professional home pages in red, blue and white. The one you pick becomes the style for every screen (Login, Check-up, Transactions, Assistant, phone).

options.label: 1 · Clean Console
options.lineage: Stripe-calibre console: light sidebar, white panels
options.thesis: The calm, precise one: everything in tidy panels, blue for data, red only for the main button and problems.
options.viewport: Headline sentence, red 'See what needs attention' button, one strip of 3 numbers, a 'where your money went' bar, then chart, payment mix, payouts table and to-do list.
options.risk: Closest to a standard dashboard; distinct mainly through the money-flow bar and plain words.

options.label: 2 · Brand Band
options.lineage: Banking-app style: navy brand band, menus along the top
options.thesis: The confident one: a deep navy band carries the headline and the 3 key numbers, white cards rise over it, menus sit across the top.
options.viewport: Top menu (Home, My business, My money, Grow, Settings), navy band with headline and 3 numbers plus a red 'See what to do' button, then chart and payout steps, then 4 big action tiles.
options.risk: Top menus hide the plain-word/technical-term labels until opened; the band uses a lot of height on small laptops.

options.label: 3 · Your Day
options.lineage: Navy sidebar with a timeline feed of today's events
options.thesis: The most distinctive one: a navy sidebar and a 'Your day so far' timeline that tells the story of today, with problems in red.
options.viewport: Big headline and 3 numbers on the left, then a timeline of today (failed payment, money landed, late payout); right column shows this week, payment mix and the October check-up.
options.risk: The timeline is new to users and needs good event writing; less room for tables on Home.
